reason: The update changes guarantees in three property areas: auto-leave now fires on an edge, is never refused, and bumps pendingConfIndex; conf-change admission is now joint-aware; and zero-payload entries are exempt from the uncommitted quota. It also adds two behaviors: newly added peers are probed immediately with Next=LastIndex, and a lead transfer to a demoted (not just removed) node is aborted. Three old properties encode the old behavior and must be revised: AutoLeaveAdvance, ProposalConfigurationDecisions and OutcomeSoundness. The old AutoLeaveAdvance encodes the repeated-trigger bug that the new regression test removes. Every other reference property stays and must be rechecked. New safety, interaction and structural properties are added for the new promises. Four violation candidates (auto-leave can be stranded after a leader change or early Advance, a duplicate leave can panic, an admission check disagrees with apply, and a quota comment overclaims) are recorded for validation, not hidden.

semantic_changes_in_update.summary: Auto-leave in advance() is edge-triggered (oldApplied < pendingConfIndex <= newApplied), uses nil Data (payload 0), cannot be refused (panic otherwise), and sets pendingConfIndex to the auto-leave entry index. reduceUncommittedSize now runs before the append.

Leader conf-change admission adds joint rules: refuse non-empty change while joint, refuse empty change while not joint (wantsLeaveJoint := len(AsV2().Changes)==0). A refused entry becomes an empty EntryNormal and the proposal is still accepted.
increaseUncommittedSize never refuses zero-payload batches (added s>0).
evidence: new/source/raft_test.go:179 (TestUncommittedEntryLimit: empty entry accepted at limit, 2*numFollowers msgs)

semantic_changes_in_update.summary: confchange initProgress uses Next=LastIndex (was LastIndex+1). switchToConfig probes all peers with maybeSendAppend(id,false) when commit did not advance. So newly added peers get a non-empty MsgApp probe immediately.
A lead transfer is aborted when the transferee is no longer in Voters.IDs(), so a demoted transferee also aborts. Before, only removal from Progress did.

Representation-only or refactor changes: campaign sends votes in sorted ID order; unstable.maybeTerm restructured; newRaft uses IsEmptyHardState; lease read uses ri; Simple no longer swallows checkInvariants failure (checkAndReturn performs it); ConfChangeV2 value receivers; Describe* helpers; rafttest/datadriven harness; seeded test network; README.

entries.why_old_is_stale: The old property requires that every Advance with cursor >= pendingConf in an AutoLeave joint config appends a leave, or records a quota-retry cursor. That is the level-triggered behavior the new regression test calls a bug: it appended several leave entries and then panicked. entries.expression:
AutoLeaveEligible(a) == /\ a.cursor > 0 /\ a.appliedFatal = "" /\ a.role = "Leader" /\ a.autoLeave /\ a.oldApplied < a.pendingBefore /\ a.cursor >= a.pendingBefore
AutoLeaveShape(e,t) == e.kind = "V2" /\ e.changes = <<>> /\ e.transition = "Auto" /\ e.id = 0 /\ e.weight = 0 /\ e.term = t
AutoLeaveAdvance_new == \A a \in history.autoLeaveChecks:
    IF AutoLeaveEligible(a)
    THEN /\ Len(a.afterHist) = a.beforeLast + 1
         /\ AutoLeaveShape(a.afterHist[a.beforeLast + 1], a.term)
         /\ a.pending = a.beforeLast + 1
         /\ a.fatal = ""
    ELSE Len(a.afterHist) = a.beforeLast
entries.notes: Both directions are checked. Not-eligible implies no append, which exposes a re-trigger (old bug). Eligible implies exactly one never-refused zero-payload leave plus the pendingConf bump. Requires the autoLeaveChecks observer extension.

entries.expression:
WantsLeaveJoint(e) == e.kind = "V2" /\ e.changes = <<>>   \* raft.go:1055 len(cc.AsV2().Changes)==0; legacy entries always carry one change
RECURSIVE RefusedConf(_,_,_,_)
RefusedConf(es,k,pend,joint) == IF k > Len(es) THEN {} ELSE
    IF es[k].kind \notin ConfKinds THEN RefusedConf(es,k+1,pend,joint)
    ELSE IF pend \/ (joint /\ ~WantsLeaveJoint(es[k])) \/ (~joint /\ WantsLeaveJoint(es[k]))
         THEN {k} \cup RefusedConf(es,k+1,pend,joint)
         ELSE RefusedConf(es,k+1,TRUE,joint)
AdmittedConf(es,pend,joint) == {k \in DOMAIN es: es[k].kind \in ConfKinds} \ RefusedConf(es,1,pend,joint)
ProposalContract_new(o) ==
  LET pend == o.pending > o.applied  joint == o.outgoing # {}
      rewritten == RefusedConf(o.entries,1,pend,joint)
      admitted  == AdmittedConf(o.entries,pend,joint)
      effective == [k \in DOMAIN o.entries |-> IF k \in rewritten THEN Entry(0,0,"Normal",0,0,0,EmptyEncoded) ELSE o.entries[k]]
      weight == Weight(effective)
      expected == IF o.role = "Leader" THEN
          IF o.node \notin o.voters \cup o.learners THEN "DropRemoved"
          ELSE IF o.transfer # 0 THEN "DropTransfer"
          ELSE IF o.quota > 0 /\ weight > 0 /\ o.quota + weight > MaxUncommitted THEN "DropQuota" ELSE "Accepted"
        ELSE IF o.role # "Follower" \/ o.lead = 0 THEN "DropNoLeader"
        ELSE IF o.noForward THEN "DropForwardDisabled" ELSE "Forwarded"
  IN /\ o.decision = expected
     /\ (o.role = "Leader" /\ expected \in {"Accepted","DropQuota"} =>
            o.pendingAfter = IF admitted = {} THEN o.pending ELSE Len(o.before) + MaxSet(admitted))
     /\ IF expected = "Accepted" THEN
          /\ Len(o.after) = Len(o.before) + Len(effective)
          /\ Prefix(o.after, Len(o.before)) = o.before
          /\ \A k \in DOMAIN effective: LET e == o.after[Len(o.before)+k] want == effective[k] IN
               /\ e.kind = want.kind /\ e.id = want.id /\ e.target = want.target
               /\ e.changes = want.changes /\ e.transition = want.transition
               /\ (e.id # 0 => e.id \in RequestId /\ o.requests[e.id].kind = e.kind /\
                    IF e.kind = "V2" THEN o.requests[e.id].changes = e.changes ELSE o.requests[e.id].target = e.target)
        ELSE o.after = o.before
ProposalConfigurationDecisions_new == \A o \in quality.proposals: ProposalContract_new(o)
entries.notes: The pendingAfter clause follows raft.go:1070, which bumps pendingConfIndex before appendEntry even on DropQuota. That index feeds both the auto-leave edge trigger and later admissions. Requires the ProposalObservation extension.
